::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 19th [1866]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/Cobweb-8
:::

My dear [Cobweb](people/person_675.qmd),
You have been very ill used, but first [Fanny Patteson](people/person_1151.qmd) was here, and I was idle, and since that I have not been well and have been more idle. The Acrostic is capital – I always like those that are all quotation- and I am very glad to see the composers going on, this last is a very entertaining piece[^1]

Pray excuse my great stupidity
your affectionate
[Mother Goose](organizations/other_104.qmd)

---

[^1]: Tiny blue envelope 92mm x 54mm addressed to Miss Helmore/ Cheyne Walk/Chelsea/ London/ S.W. postmarked Winchester 19 March 1866 and London 20 March 1866.
[^2]: Helmore was contributing a series of articles on composers to the *[Barnacle](organizations/other_89.qmd)*.
